release_notes:
What's New in v1.1.5

- Selective Video Call Scheduling: You can now pick specific participants by registration name to receive call rings, or choose 'Select All' to invite everyone.
- Selective Ringing: Video call ring notifications are sent only to the selected invitees instead of ringing for all members.
- Real-time Contact Search: Filter members instantly by name or phone in the call scheduler.
- General stability, audio clarity, and performance improvements across live prayer meetings.
